gates.name: authentic product and documentary imagery system

assumptions: The authorized repository owner controls the operational source repository and authorizes this kingXford & Co implementation.
English is the only language required for this release.
Authentic public-product captures document only the visible interface state at capture time; they do not assert ownership, affiliation, endorsement, performance, or a documented outcome.
Licensed documentary photography is contextual and does not assert that a pictured person, property, facility, tool, or activity belongs to kingXford & Co or a represented project.
CCAI Global, Aceplore, Nkosuo, and Elkings College remain unreleased until a separately verified status change.
No narration asset is shipped; future audio remains optional and must pass the documented consent, editorial, and listening review before publication.
No environment variables are required for the public portfolio unless the deployment workflow reports otherwise.
open_questions: Which direct company email or form destination should be used for the company-safe contact path?
Should a future release connect a custom CMS for project and Media publishing?
Should a future Media release commission a professional narrator or approve a disclosed, editorially reviewed synthetic voice under creative/narration-policy.md?

risks.mitigation: Use factual alt text and visible contextual captions where appropriate; never describe a source photograph as a kingXford & Co person, facility, engagement, experiment, partnership, or result.
Limit edits to crop, scale, framing, neutral layout fields, and encoding; compare every active composition with its authentic public capture and prohibit invented interface content.
Keep CCAI Global, Aceplore, Nkosuo, and Elkings College explicitly unreleased across cards, detail routes, metadata, and calls to action; do not use them as published-product proof.
Use optimized local WebP plates, CSS/Motion transforms, native scroll, and a reduced-motion static path.
Deploy and verify the Vercel production URL; treat custom-domain DNS as a separate owner-controlled configuration.

Record reference and publication years, retain official links and interpretation boundaries beside every visual, and re-verify figures before a dated article update rather than silently replacing values.

project_release_state.rule: Unreleased case studies may explain work in progress but must never be presented as published products, current deployments, validated outcomes, or active proof until status and destination are explicitly re-verified.

historical_assets.rule: Prior generated, synthetic, hybrid, and superseded identity assets remain preserved for audit history only and are not referenced by active release surfaces.
